subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 11th day of Mar 2026.
source_quote: Date: Mar 11th, 2026

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: the guttural roar of a lion twisted together with the frantic, deranged bleating of a giant goat

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: chimera chain
fact: The heavy iron collar and dragging chains used to control the beast are stamped with the marks of Nulb's River Pirates, revealing that someone in Nulb was paid to deliver the monster to the temple.
source_quote: The heavy iron collar and chains used to control the beast were stamped with the marks of Nulb's River Pirates

subject: gold amulet value
fact: A heavy gold amulet bearing the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple was found on the warlock.
source_quote: A heavy gold amulet depicting the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple is found on the warlock.

subject: potion of fire resistance
fact: A potion of fire resistance was recovered, which the warlock had apparently intended to use but never reached for in the chaos.
source_quote: A potion of fire resistance is recovered, which the warlock had apparently intended to use but never reached for in the chaos.

subject: masterwork whip
fact: A masterwork whip woven with alchemically treated red leather was found among the warlock's belongings.
source_quote: A masterwork whip woven with alchemically treated red leather is found among the warlock's belongings.

subject: ledger of purchase
fact: A wax-sealed ledger bearing the crest of a crimson ship — a bill of sale from Captain Varsik of the Crimson Trader — details the purchase of the Chimera paid in full by the Fire Temple.
source_quote: A wax-sealed ledger bore the crest of a crimson ship — a bill of sale from Captain Varsik of the Crimson Trader, detailing the purchase of the Chimera paid in full by the Fire Temple.

subject: Hartsch's ambition
fact: Hartsch implies he would be willing to take command if a position were to 'suddenly open itself', signaling to the party that he wants them to remove Romag.
source_quote: I would always, if a position were to suddenly have opened itself, I would absolutely like to think that my faith and my leadership qualities would be considered.

subject: Zinnia's deception
fact: Zinnia uses deception to suggest to Hartsch that he would be a superior leader to Romag.
source_quote: Zinnia uses deception to suggest to Hartsch that he would be a superior leader to Romag.

subject: party's quarters
fact: The room where the party attempted to take a long rest, featuring a southern door and a secret door. The Chimera smashed through the door here, leading to a desperate struggle, and the room later served as a private meeting place with Hartsch.
source_quote: The room where the party attempted to take a long rest, featuring a southern door and a secret door.

subject: romag's chambers
fact: The command center for the Earth Temple where Romag and Hartsch coordinate their forces. The party reported the chimera attack here and received orders to deal with Alrrem.
source_quote: The command center for the Earth Temple where Romag and Hartsch coordinate their forces.

subject: fire temple warlock
fact: A servant of Alrrem who led a Chimera on a chain to assassinate the party. He used magical blasts and commanded the beast until Zephyr disarmed him of the chain. He was ultimately slain by Zinnia.
source_quote: A servant of Alrrem who led a Chimera on a chain to assassinate the party. He used magical blasts and commanded the beast until Zephyr disarmed him of the chain. He was ultimately slain by Zinnia.

subject: chimera
fact: A horrific multi-headed monstrosity with the features of a lion, a goat, and a dragon, imported by the Fire Temple at great expense to destroy the party. It went on a mindless rampage after being freed from its chains and was ultimately slain by Calmer's necrotic magic.
source_quote: A horrific multi-headed monstrosity with the features of a lion, a goat, and a dragon, imported by the Fire Temple at great expense to destroy the party. It went on a mindless rampage after being freed from its chains and was ultimately slain by Calmer's necrotic magic.

subject: bugbear
fact: A guard or observer who attempted to intervene in the chaos by pointing a weapon at the Chimera, but was caught in the beast's devastating breath attack.
source_quote: A bugbear attempts to distract the Chimera by pointing a weapon at it, but the beast unleashes a devastating breath attack on both the warlock and the bugbear.

subject: calmer
fact: A cleric and party member who healed fallen companions and ultimately slew the Chimera. His companions grew concerned that he may be genuinely embracing his Earth Temple cover identity rather than simply acting.
source_quote: A cleric and party member who healed fallen companions and ultimately slew the Chimera. His companions grew concerned that he may be genuinely embracing his Earth Temple cover identity rather than simply acting.

subject: romag
fact: The leader of the Earth Temple who prefers to lead from behind, viewing himself as a chess king who sends others to fight his battles. He ordered the party to deal with Alrrem after hearing of the chimera attack.
source_quote: The leader of the Earth Temple who prefers to lead from behind, viewing himself as a chess king who sends others to fight his battles. He ordered the party to deal with Alrrem after hearing of the chimera attack.

subject: hartsch
fact: Romag's sub-general and speaker who provided the party with tactical information and maps. He revealed the political landscape of the temples and subtly signaled his desire for the party to remove Romag from power so he could take command.
source_quote: Romag's sub-general and speaker who provided the party with tactical information and maps. He revealed the political landscape of the temples and subtly signaled his desire for the party to remove Romag from power so he could take command.

subject: alrrem
fact: The leader of the Fire Temple, currently weakened after losing his werewolves and his expensive chimera asset. He was originally the leader of the temples in the great battle of Emridy Meadows and has been struggling to hold power since.
source_quote: The leader of the Fire Temple, currently weakened after losing his werewolves and his expensive chimera asset. He was originally the leader of the temples in the great battle of Emridy Meadows and has been struggling to hold power since.

subject: belsornig
fact: The Prophet and head of the Water Temple, suspected by Hartsch of being a cunning manipulator who arranged the chimera purchase through his ally Vesrek as a win-win scheme against both the Fire and Earth temples.
source_quote: Vesrek, an ally of Belsornig the prophet of the Water Temple, was the one who arranged the chimera purchase — suggesting the Water Temple manipulated the situation as a win-win.

subject: kelno
fact: The Prophet of the Air Temple, dismissed by Hartsch as a joke with very little remaining power or territory, reduced to a few rooms within the temple.
source_quote: The Prophet of the Air Temple, dismissed by Hartsch as a joke with very little remaining power or territory, reduced to a few rooms within the temple.

subject: vesrek
fact: An ally of Belsornig, the Water Temple prophet, who is identified in the ledger as the one who arranged the purchase of the chimera for the Fire Temple through Captain Varsik of the Crimson Trader.
source_quote: Vesrek, an ally of Belsornig the prophet of the Water Temple, was the one who arranged the chimera purchase — suggesting the Water Temple manipulated the situation as a win-win.

subject: chimera's rampage
fact: The Chimera unleashed a devastating breath of fire upon both the warlock and a nearby bugbear who had tried to intervene, scorching them badly.
source_quote: The Chimera unleashed a devastating breath of fire upon both the warlock and a nearby bugbear who had tried to intervene, scorching them badly.

subject: zephyr's chain snatch
fact: Zephyr slips past the rampaging Chimera and rips the control chain from the Fire Temple warlock's hands, sending the beast into an uncontrolled frenzy.
source_quote: Zephyr slips past the rampaging Chimera and rips the control chain from the Fire Temple warlock's hands, sending the beast into an uncontrolled frenzy.

subject: calmer's final blow
fact: Calmer invokes necrotic power, finally slaying the Chimera as it stands over the fallen party members.
source_quote: Calmer invokes necrotic power, finally slaying the Chimera as it stands over the fallen party members.

subject: zinnia's final strike
fact: Zinnia silenced him permanently with a flurry of devastating blows, leaving the Fire Temple's champion dead on the stone floor.
source_quote: Zinnia silenced him permanently with a flurry of devastating blows, leaving the Fire Temple's champion dead on the stone floor.

subject: three-way war plan
fact: The party quietly agreed that the time for subtlety was nearly over, planning to assassinate Romag, install Hartsch as the Earth Temple's new leader, and engineer a three-way war between the Earth, Fire, and Water temples to destroy all three factions from within.
source_quote: The party quietly agreed that the time for subtlety was nearly over.

subject: heavy iron collar and dragging chains
fact: A heavy iron collar and dragging chains used by the Fire Temple warlock to control and goad the Chimera into battle were later found to be stamped with the marks of Nulb's River Pirates, revealing that someone in Nulb was paid to deliver the monster.
source_quote: The chains were later found to be stamped with the marks of Nulb's River Pirates, revealing that someone in Nulb was paid to deliver the monster.

subject: Warlock's Ledger
fact: A document found on the Fire Temple warlock, containing a heavy wax-sealed receipt bearing the crest of a crimson ship, is a bill of sale from Captain Varsik of the Crimson Trader detailing the purchase of the chimera, paid in full by the Fire Temple, and revealed a connection to Vesrek, an ally of the Water Temple's prophet Belsornig.
source_quote: A document found on the Fire Temple warlock, containing a heavy wax-sealed receipt bearing the crest of a crimson ship. It is a bill of sale from Captain Varsik of the Crimson Trader detailing the purchase of the chimera, paid in full by the Fire Temple. It also revealed a connection to Vesrek, an ally of the Water Temple's prophet Belsornig.

subject: Fire Temple Amulet
fact: A heavy gold amulet and chain depicting the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple, found on the warlock, has craftsmanship and gold weight that make it worth 100 gold pieces.
source_quote: A heavy gold amulet and chain depicting the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple, found on the warlock. Its craftsmanship and gold weight make it worth 100 gold pieces.

subject: Potion of Fire Resistance
fact: A magical elixir found on the warlock, intended to protect the user from heat and flames, was on the warlock's person but he panicked and never reached for it during the chaos of the chimera's rampage.
source_quote: A magical elixir found on the warlock, intended to protect the user from heat and flames. The warlock had it on his person but panicked and never reached for it during the chaos of the chimera's rampage.

subject: Masterwork Whip
fact: A high-quality whip woven with alchemically treated red leather, found among the warlock's belongings, is of fine craftsmanship, features a ten-foot reach, and can slow an enemy's movement.
source_quote: A high-quality whip woven with alchemically treated red leather, found among the warlock's belongings. While not magical, it is of fine craftsmanship, features a ten-foot reach, and can slow an enemy's movement.

subject: Eldritch Blast
fact: Beams of crackling energy fired by the Fire Temple warlock at Sequioa, dealing significant damage early in the fight.
source_quote: Beams of crackling energy fired by the Fire Temple warlock at Sequioa, dealing significant damage early in the fight.

subject: Healing Word
fact: A quick divine incantation used by Calmer on two separate occasions during the battle — first to restore Sequioa to consciousness, and later to bring Zephyr back from the brink of death.
source_quote: A quick divine incantation used by Calmer on two separate occasions during the battle — first to restore Sequioa to consciousness, and later to bring Zephyr back from the brink of death.

subject: Toll the Dead
fact: A necrotic spell cast by Calmer that manifests as the sound of a melancholy tolling bell, was used multiple times during the fight and ultimately delivered the final, fatal blow to the wounded Chimera.
source_quote: A necrotic spell cast by Calmer that manifests as the sound of a melancholy tolling bell. It was used multiple times during the fight and ultimately delivered the final, fatal blow to the wounded Chimera.
